backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles, balances, and an admin wallet with authorization checks and fund distribution.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence list describing UI and query updates related to admin wallet display and error handling.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of multiple frontend files covering components, hooks, pages, utilities, and assets.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based styles defining OKLCH color variables for light/dark themes and base styling.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML template mounting the React app with Vite module entrypoint.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with routes for home, credits, status, admin, dashboard, and profile using AppLayout as root.
frontend/src/components/AppFooter.tsx: Footer with referral link sharing, copy-to-clipboard, branding, and credits link.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Header with branding and profile button that dynamically updates BalanceIndicator offset via ResizeObserver.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Root layout rendering a background image, BalanceIndicator, routed content, and global toaster.
frontend/src/components/BalanceIndicator: Displays user balance and, for admins, the admin wallet balance using React Query hooks with conditional loading and UI states.
frontend/src/components/OrderConfirmatio: Displays order confirmation details, including package info, video URL, and next steps, with links to view status or create another order.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUrl.ts: Returns the current browser URL on mount.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication, exposing identity state, login, logout, and status helpers via context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for user profile, balance, admin checks, and fund distribution using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light/dark themes with layout utility classes.
frontend/src/lib/backendError.ts: Converts backend error messages into cleaner, user-friendly text.
frontend/src/lib/copyToClipboard.ts: Copies text to the clipboard using the Clipboard API with a legacy fallback.
frontend/src/lib/format.ts: Formatting helpers for timestamps, order IDs, PKR values, and balances.
frontend/src/lib/packages.ts: Defines available boost packages with pricing, descriptions, and benefits.
frontend/src/lib/validation.ts: Validates URLs, ensuring non-empty and proper HTTP/HTTPS format.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Displays admin analytics with wallet balance, handling loading and error states, and includes system information cards.
frontend/src/pages/CreditsPage.tsx: Shows credits and project details, including features, contact info, and an educational-use notice.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Provides admin dashboard tools to place local orders, manage balance, copy invite links, and distribute funds.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Public landing page that highlights packages, validates TikTok URLs, and submits order requests with notifications.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Allows authenticated users to view, edit, and save profile details, upload avatars, and manage Internet Identity login state.
frontend/src/pages/StatusPage.tsx: Displays placeholder order-status information and directs users to contact Telegram support for updates.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash mode), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them from storage or the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme extensions, custom colors, fonts, animations, and enables typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s current architecture, wallet system requirements, UI decisions, known issues, and existing features for build planning.
